brief:
The Hind Rajab Foundation filed a criminal complaint with Italian authorities against an Israeli soldier vacationing in Tuscany, accusing him of participating in war crimes, crimes against humanity, and genocide, Shehab Wire reported. The foundation, named after a Palestinian child killed in Gaza, submitted the complaint to Italian prosecutors.

The move reflects efforts by Palestinian rights organizations to pursue legal accountability through international jurisdictions for alleged Israeli military conduct.
